sources.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office / Polis Center at IUPUI; Indiana Statewide LiDAR Derived Building Footprints layer
sources.method: Queried polygons within 80 m of manifest placement. Selected 441814: source polygon bbox center is within 0.313 m of prior massing bbox center; its polygon area centroid is 1.611 m from that center because the southern stem shifts the centroid. It has an 8-vertex T-shaped outline plus a closing coordinate. Vertices were inverse-projected then transformed to repository local XY. No scale fitting applied.
sources.uncertainty: Automated LiDAR footprint extraction, published as-is; not a survey. Service area/perimeter use map-plane units, while local metrics apply the project local conversion.

sources.crs: EPSG:3857 export bbox; image has no embedded CRS; export parameters and service metadata preserved beside it
sources.method: Plan-view comparison: T-shaped footprint aligns with T-shaped roof, with north crossbar and southern projecting wing; roof edge and ridge details are visually estimated.

sources.provider: Purdue Geospatial Data Science Lab / Indiana Digital Forestry, Indiana 2017-2019 3DEP LiDAR NDHM
sources.feature_identifier: Tippecanoe 2018 NDHM tile in2018_29951885_12_ndhm.tif; queried BStF tile footprint OBJECTID 35356; 5-ft pixels
sources.method: Sampled raster cell centers inside feature 441814 after projection from EPSG:3857. 191 raw cells were sampled; 177 values between 2 and 25 ft were retained for robust roof-surface quantiles. p10–p90 are approximately 4.45–5.81 m overall; crossbar and south stem medians are 5.07 m and 5.14 m. Source tile, tile query, and reproducible sampling script/results are preserved beside this record.
sources.uncertainty: 5-ft cells, automated footprint, and tree canopy/edge mixing limit the reading. NDHM values are normalized roof/vegetation surface heights and are not measured wall, eave, or ridge elevations. Values above 25 ft were excluded as likely canopy returns, but some vegetation may remain; no floor count or roof pitch is directly measured.

geometry_and_design.source_date: 2018 lidar collection; statewide dataset publication date 2022-08-08
geometry_and_design.local_frame: EPSG:3857 vertices inverse-projected to geographic, then approximate Purdue campus local XY per modular/AGENTS.md: X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274 radians), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040

prior_massing_bbox_m.height_note: Historical pre-revision simple-massing bound only; current reopened detailed asset height is recorded separately as 6.0 m.

revision.structural_footprint: Feature 441814 vertex ring after inverse Web Mercator and local-frame transform; no fit-to-bounds scaling applied.

estimated_vertical_design_m.basis: Design proxies guided by 2018 NDHM roof-surface samples (roughly 4.45 m p10 to 5.81 m p90 after canopy/outlier filtering); these are not measured eave/ridge elevations.

geometry_and_design.uncertainty: The Indiana statewide footprint is LiDAR-derived and not a survey. SHAPE__Area/Length are service properties in EPSG:3857 map units; local-plan metrics above use the repository approximate ground conversion. The 2018 NDHM is 5-ft resolution, normalized roof/vegetation surface height; 2-25 ft cells were retained for robust roof summaries, but possible canopy overlap remains. It does not provide measured eave/ridge values, exact floor count, gable pitch, facade rhythm, or entrance dimensions.

mesh_topology.assessment: Intentional open architectural surface representation: the 32 boundary edges on the eight footprint wall panels, 12 on the four gable roof planes, and 12 on the two gable-end faces are expected. They are render skins without modeled thickness or an interior; decorative facade parts are separate closed meshes. This check asserts there are exactly these open boundaries and no others. The asset is not watertight, and no unsupported wall thickness/interior is invented.

remaining_uncertainty: No published measured heights or floor plans located.

Vertical design proxies are estimates guided by 2018 NDHM roof-surface quantiles; no eave/ridge elevations or floor count are measured. Facade windows, entrance dimensions/location, roof pitch, and colors remain approximate from dated imagery.
The NDHM sample distribution is similar on the north crossbar and south stem; a distinct low roof level is not supported by these samples.
The 2018 LiDAR footprint is automated; no cadastral or boundary survey was available.

independent_grade.reviewed_revision: 6.0 m asset height; 183 objects; correct 2018 NDHM tile and revised roof profile
remaining_uncertainty: No surveyed absolute XY control point or published measured height/floor plan.
Facade/window/entrance details, floor count, and roof pitch remain approximate from dated low-resolution imagery.
The asset uses intentional open architectural surface skins; it is not a watertight solid and has no modeled interior.
